globals
 timer cpTimer=null
 integer cpTick=0
 integer cpScene=0
 unit cpA=null
 unit cpH=null
 unit cpB=null
endglobals
function CpBool takes boolean b returns integer
 if b then
 return 1
 endif
 return 0
endfunction
function CpLog takes string s returns nothing
 if StringLength(s)>160 then
 call Preload("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=OVERLONG")
 else
 call Preload(s)
 endif
endfunction
function CpSample takes string label returns nothing
 call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label="+label+" ah="+I2S(GetUnitCurrentOrder(cpA))+" hh="+I2S(GetUnitCurrentOrder(cpH))+" bh="+I2S(GetUnitCurrentOrder(cpB)))
 call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=apos x="+R2S(GetUnitX(cpA))+" y="+R2S(GetUnitY(cpA))+" type="+I2S(GetUnitTypeId(cpA))+" life="+R2S(GetWidgetLife(cpA)))
 call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=hpos x="+R2S(GetUnitX(cpH))+" y="+R2S(GetUnitY(cpH))+" type="+I2S(GetUnitTypeId(cpH))+" life="+R2S(GetWidgetLife(cpH)))
endfunction
function CpEvent takes nothing returns nothing
 call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=issued id="+I2S(GetIssuedOrderId())+" actor="+I2S(GetUnitUserData(GetTriggerUnit()))+" target="+I2S(GetUnitUserData(GetOrderTargetUnit())))
 call CpSample("issued-state")
endfunction
function CpSpell takes nothing returns nothing
 call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=spell event="+I2S(GetHandleId(GetTriggerEventId()))+" actor="+I2S(GetUnitUserData(GetTriggerUnit()))+" ability="+I2S(GetSpellAbilityId()))
endfunction
function CpRemove takes nothing returns nothing
 call RemoveUnit(GetEnumUnit())
endfunction
function CpTick takes nothing returns nothing
 local integer age=0
 local boolean ok=false
 local group g=null
 set cpTick=cpTick+1
 set cpScene=(cpTick-1)/1000
 set age=ModuloInteger(cpTick-1,1000)+1
 if age==1 then
  set cpA=CreateUnit(Player(0),'earc',512.0,512.0,0.0)
  set cpH=CreateUnit(Player(0),'ehip',1024.0,512.0,180.0)
  set cpB=CreateUnit(Player(0),'earc',1100.0,512.0,180.0)
  call SetUnitUserData(cpA,1)
  call SetUnitUserData(cpH,2)
  call SetUnitUserData(cpB,3)
  call SetUnitAcquireRange(cpA,0.0)
  call SetUnitAcquireRange(cpH,0.0)
  call SetUnitAcquireRange(cpB,0.0)
  call CpSample("setup")
  call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=abilities a="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(cpA,'Aco2'))+" h="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(cpH,'Aco3'))+" b="+I2S(GetUnitAbilityLevel(cpB,'Aco2')))
 elseif age==100 and cpScene<2 then
  call CpSample("before")
  if cpScene==0 then
   set ok=IssueTargetOrder(cpA,"coupletarget",cpH)
  else
   set ok=IssueImmediateOrder(cpA,"coupleinstant")
  endif
  call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=initial-return accepted="+I2S(CpBool(ok)))
  call CpSample("after")
 elseif age==700 then
  call CpSample("before-retry")
  set ok=IssueTargetOrder(cpB,"coupletarget",cpH)
  call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=retry-return accepted="+I2S(CpBool(ok)))
  call CpSample("after-retry")
 elseif age==750 then
  set ok=IssueTargetOrder(cpH,"coupletarget",cpB)
  call CpLog("CPF tick="+I2S(cpTick)+" scene="+I2S(cpScene)+" label=peer-return accepted="+I2S(CpBool(ok)))
 elseif age==999 then
  call CpSample("settled")
